venues.name: Jebel Jais Summit Trail
venues.description: Demanding summit route in the UAE's highest peak area — panoramic Hajar views.

venues.name: Jebel Jais Left Trail (Stairway to Heaven)
venues.nameAr: مسار جبل جيس الأيسر — سلم إلى الجنة
venues.description: Steep ridge hike on the left flank of Jebel Jais — often called Stairway to Heaven. Start from the lower Jais road pull-offs.

venues.name: Jebel Jais Right Trail (Stairway to Heaven)
venues.nameAr: مسار جبل جيس الأيمن — سلم إلى الجنة
venues.description: Classic Jais ridge route on the right side — same Stairway to Heaven name locals use for both flanks. Exposed sections; go early in winter.

venues.name: Wadi Shawka Loop
venues.description: Popular wadi loop with pools, dam views, and family-friendly sections.

venues.name: Wadi Shawka Dam Trail
venues.description: Out-and-back from Shawka Dam parking — pools and canyon walls in the main wadi bed.

venues.name: Wadi Shawka Pools Trail
venues.description: Shorter hike to seasonal pools upstream of the dam — busy after winter rain.

venues.name: Wadi Shawka Mountain Trail
venues.description: Higher ridge and saddle routes above Shawka — moderate to hard; carry extra water.

venues.name: Hatta Dam Loop
venues.description: Easy lakeside loop around Hatta Dam with mountain backdrop.

venues.name: Fossil Rock
venues.description: Classic Sharjah desert hike to the Fossil Rock formation — a weekend favourite.

venues.name: Al Rabi Hiking Trail
venues.description: Coastal ridge trail above Khor Fakkan with sea and mountain views.

venues.name: Al Rafisah Dam — The Walk
venues.description: Scenic dam and lakeside walk popular with families near Khor Fakkan.

venues.name: Rafisah Dam Hike Summit
venues.description: Upper viewpoint loop above Al Rafisah Dam.

venues.name: Wadi Naqab Hiking Starting Point
venues.description: Marked wadi hike with cave sections — common northern RAK trailhead.

venues.name: Wadi Al Abadilah
venues.description: Green wadi hike on the east coast — pools and farms between the mountains.

venues.name: Wadi Shees
venues.description: Oasis and pool wadi near Kalba — short hikes and picnic spots.

venues.name: Wadi Shah
venues.description: East-coast wadi hikes between Khor Fakkan and the mountains — pools and farms in season.

venues.name: Wadi Sah
venues.description: Green wadi and village trails inland from the Fujairah coast — often grouped with nearby Shah and Helo hikes.

venues.name: Wadi Al Helo
venues.description: Historic wadi with fort ruins and canyon walks — Kalba / Fujairah border area.

venues.name: Rainbow Valley Hiking
venues.description: Colourful mineral slopes and wadi paths north of Dibba.

venues.name: Fujairah Adventures — Dibba Hiking Trail
venues.description: Operator-marked coastal mountain trail in the Dibba area.

venues.name: Fujairah Adventure — Al Dahir Trekking
venues.description: Mountain trekking routes in the Al Dahir area inland from the coast.

venues.name: Green Mountains Dhadna
venues.description: Terraced farms and green slopes above Dhadna — gentle to moderate hikes.

venues.name: Wadi Sena
venues.description: Wadi hiking and camp access between Fujairah mountain villages.

venues.name: Hatta Hiking Trail Network
venues.description: Signposted colour trails (green, blue, red, black) around Hatta Wadi Hub.

venues.name: Hatta Sign Hike
venues.description: Ridge hike to the iconic Hatta sign viewpoint — steep climb with wide dam and mountain views.

venues.name: Jebel Hafeet Summit Road Hike
venues.description: Summit road and ridge walks on Al Ain's iconic mountain.

venues.name: Wadi Al Aqr
venues.description: Desert–mountain wadi hikes on the RAK–Sharjah border.

venues.name: Fossil Rock Desert Camp
venues.description: Group desert camping near Fossil Rock — stargazing and sunrise hikes.

venues.name: Dibba Beach Camp
venues.description: Beach camping on the Gulf of Oman below the Hajar Mountains.

venues.name: Wadi Kub Camp Spot
venues.description: Mountain wadi camp spot — check access and weather before overnight stays.

venues.name: Kalba Kingfisher Lodge Camp
venues.description: Mangrove and mountain-edge camping near Kalba.

venues.name: Sharjah East — Wild Camp Views
venues.description: Wild camp spots with wadi and mountain views east of Sharjah city.

venues.name: Al Qudra Lakes Camping
venues.description: Designated lakeside camping between Al Qudra and Love Lake — popular Dubai weekend spot; book where required.

venues.name: Love Lake — Al Qudra
venues.description: Heart-shaped lake area in the Al Qudra desert — day visits and nearby camp zones.

venues.name: Al Qudra — Last Exit Camp Area
venues.description: Desert camping access off the Al Qudra / Bab Al Shams road corridor — check current access rules.

venues.name: Hatta Wadi Hub Camping
venues.description: Mountain camping and glamping near Hatta trailheads and the dam.

venues.name: Wadi Shawka Camp Spot
venues.description: Weekend camp spots near Shawka Dam — combine with day hikes in the wadi.

venues.name: Jebel Jais Viewing Deck Camp
venues.description: High-altitude camping and stargazing near Jais viewing areas — cold nights in winter.

venues.name: Liwa Desert Camping
venues.description: Empty Quarter edge dunes — organised camps and self-drive spots south of Abu Dhabi.

venues.name: Al Badayer Desert Camp
venues.description: Red dune desert camping near Big Red / Al Badayer — 4×4 recommended.

venues.name: Mleiha Desert Camp
venues.description: Desert camps and fossil dune access in the Mleiha area — stargazing and dune walks.
